name: Fatima Taj
title: Senior Software Engineer @ Yelp; LinkedIn Learning Instructor
bio:
Fatima is a Senior Software Engineer at Yelp and a LinkedIn Learning Instructor with a passion for ensuring there is no knowledge gatekeeping in tech. An experienced international speaker, Fatima has presented at leading conferences including Harvard WeCode, Berlin Buzzwords, Developer Week, SCALE, NDC Copenhagen Developer Festival, Women of Silicon Roundabout, cdCon+GitOpsCon (as a keynote), and Momentum, as well as at more than 80 hackathons across North America.

With a master's degree in Data Science from HEC Montreal and a bachelor's degree in Mathematics from the University of Waterloo, Fatima combines technical expertise with a commitment to building an inclusive and supportive tech community. Her mission is simple: make knowledge in tech open to all.
